headlines.title: Trump says he could pull Blanche's attorney general nomination until GOP holdouts leave
headlines.description: In a post on social media, President Trump threatened to pull acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve permanently in the role until two Senate Republicans who are withholding their support leave office next year. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports from Capitol Hill on why the senators oppose advancing Blanche's nomination to the full Senate.

headlines.title: US Strikes Iran in Wake of Surprise Attack on American Forces
headlines.description: The United States launched major strikes against Iran Thursday morning after President Donald Trump vowed to hit the regime “very hard” as retaliation for a surprise attack on American forces in the region earlier in the week. It comes as a new poll shows 72% of Americans disapprove of the president's handling of Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Democrat Mandela Barnes drops out of the Wisconsin governor’s race
headlines.description: Former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes said Thursday that he is dropping out of the Democratic race for governor in Wisconsin.

headlines.title: Father of Apalachee High School shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
headlines.description: The man who gifted his 14-year-old son an assault rifle that he then used to unleash a mass shooting at Apalachee High School in Georgia was sentenced to 15 years in prison. A jury convicted Colin Gray on multiple charges, including second-degree murder and involuntary manslaughter. His son was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. NBC News' George Solis reports.

headlines.title: Battling wildfires across Europe
headlines.description: Fires continue to rage across Europe, including in France’s wine country. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez was with firefighters and volunteers in the region as they battled the flames.

headlines.title: ‘Children of Blood and Bone’ author Tomi Adeyemi says she left set of film adaptation in tears
headlines.description: Author Tomi Adeyemi, whose novel “Children of Blood and Bone” is being made into a movie, said in a TikTok video that she left the set of the book’s film adaptation in tears.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: States push DHS to explain its noncitizen voter claims
headlines.description: State officials are pushing back on the Department of Homeland Security’s claims that it found tens of thousands of noncitizens on their voter rolls, asking the department to explain how it arrived at its conclusion.

headlines.title: Apalachee High School shooter’s dad sentenced to 15 years
headlines.description: Colin Gray, the man who gifted his son an assault rifle the teenager used to shoot up a Georgia high school in 2024 was sentenced to prison on Thursday.

headlines.title: Ben Affleck wins $1 million for charity on ‘Who Wants To Be a Millionaire’
headlines.description: Ben Affleck was overcome with glee the moment he won “Who Wants To Be a Millionaire,” jumping up to hug his partner, “Jeopardy!” champion Jamie Ding.
